nina: Heads-up: AcmeHW dry-run in sandbox at 11:30 PST. Focus: batch ack semantics + paired recon CSV generation.

rail: Uploads done -> s3://partner-tests/acmehw/dryrun/2025-04-02/. Files: `batch_001.json`, `batch_001.signatures.txt`, `expected_delta_preview.csv`.

ops-bot: sandbox: webhook v2025-04-02 deployed. replay API available: POST /internal/replay?mode=preview. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/replays/1765551111/logs

partner-success: Can partners push a redelivery with same idempotent_id but different usage_units to simulate correction?

nina: Yes. We accept corrected events if signed. Our rule: same idempotent_id + later `sequence_no` wins. If you resend, include `sequence_no` and new signature in `X-Partner-Signature`.

rail: Note: preview mode marks ledger rows as `preview_only=true` so no billing. Use `mode=commit` + signed approval to persist. Also beware ms vs s epochs; we normalize both.

partner-success: Great. We'll schedule partner SREs and share curl examples. Also need a short README explaining how to request commit.

nina: Drafted commit SOP in the repo and linked it in the dry-run folder. After preview completes, we'll generate `recon_preview.csv` and a human-friendly PDF for Acme ops.

ops-bot: replay job started: id `dryrun-1765551111`. Processed 2,420 events, detected 12 corrected events, preview deltas written to s3.

rail: I'll run the reconcile script and post the summary in 10m.
